Sabey Corp. and National Real Estate Advisors have announced that Ares Secondaries funds have expanded their investment in Sabey Data Center Properties (SDCP), an owner, developer and operator of data centers across the United States. The additional commitment builds on Ares’ minority equity investment in SDCP announced in July 2026, bringing the total investment to more than $500 million.

SDCP is a fully integrated data center platform that owns and operates hyperscale and enterprise data center campuses located in top-tier U.S. data center markets totaling 275 megawatts, with an expansion pipeline expected to reach approximately 737 megawatts by 2033.

p: Sabey Corp.와 National Real Estate Advisors는 미국 전역에서 데이터센터를 소유, 개발 및 운영하는 Sabey Data Center Properties (SDCP)에 대해 Ares Secondaries 펀드가 투자를 확대했다고 발표했다. 이번 추가 출자는 2026년 7월에 발표된 Ares의 SDCP 소수지분 투자를 바탕으로 이루어졌으며, 이를 통해 총투자금액은 5억 달러 이상으로 늘어났다.
